text:
(ESA 2021) Observe the extract below:
“Everybody’s going on holiday”, Bill said. He laughed. “It’s going to be wonderful. No work for two weeks”

Choose the option in which you can observe the same verb tense as in the underlined words.
options: We can playing basketball really well.
I am eating. Can you call me later?
She is going home every weekend.
I studying Japanese. It is fantastic!
subject: Inglês
explanation: A frase usa o presente contínuo ("am eating"), que é o mesmo tempo verbal de "going" no extrato ("is/are going"). O contexto de uma ação em andamento ou situação atual alinha-se com o uso do presente contínuo, tornando-a a escolha adequada.
